pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown polygons with jagged, crenelated margins and sharp pixel gradients. Patches exhibit high edge complexity with dendritic or leaf-like projections into the interstitial space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream pathways forming a reticulated topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with a relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal ridge, manifesting as short, dense vertical spikes against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, localized silhouettes (avian-shaped) perched along the dorsal ridge, creating distinct interruptions in the mane's geometric profile.
